title: Insha ya Wasifu (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans a wasifu in three parts: a short introduction, a body with features grouped (appearance, character, work), and a closing on why it matters.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a wasifu with describing words.
floor.question: Eleza rafiki yako kwa sentensi moja.
floor.answer: Rafiki yangu ni mfupi na mcheshi.

representations: a model wasifu with parts labelled

board.say: Kiini kina makundi gani ya sifa?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the plan for a person he admires.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sehemu ya mwisho ya insha huitwa ___." Kwa nini "utangulizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ina kichwa juu, kisha utangulizi (mwanzo), mwili (katikati) na hitimisho (mwisho).

misconceptions.ask: Aya yako ya kwanza ina mambo mangapi?
misconceptions.repair: Utangulizi hutambulisha kwa ufupi; kiini hueleza sifa kwa kina.
Panga sifa kwa makundi: sura, tabia, kazi.
Hitimisho hufunga kwa kueleza umuhimu wa mtu au kitu.

checks.question: Sifa za sura, tabia na kazi ziwekwe wapi?
checks.answer: katika kiini, kila kundi aya yake

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya wasifu before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Dada Yangu Mhandisi".

misconceptions.repair: Insha ya wasifu hueleza jinsi kitu au mtu alivyo, si matukio ya siku moja.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anaona nini akisoma sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia vivumishi na maelezo ya rangi, umbo, ukubwa na sauti ili msomaji aone picha.

misconceptions.ask: Nomino hii iko katika ngeli gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kivumishi hupatana na nomino yake: bendera nzuri, miti mirefu, mtoto mzuri.

listen_for: Rafiki yangu ana baiskeli mpya ya rangi ya bluu.
misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inahusiana vipi na anwani?
misconceptions.repair: Kila sentensi ya insha inapaswa kuhusu anwani.

misconceptions.ask: Aya yako ya kwanza inafanya kazi gani?
misconceptions.repair: Insha ina utangulizi, kiini chenye aya kadhaa, na hitimisho.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya wasifu kuhusu "Dada Yangu Mhandisi"?
checks.answer: Dada yangu ni mrefu, mchangamfu, na huvaa kofia ngumu ya njano kazini.

checks.question: Insha ya wasifu ina sehemu zipi?
